shell.authorizeIntro: Start a new shell session with the permissions of the <project>{projectName}</project> project.
shell.permissionsBody: OpenStack API calls use the permissions of the signed-in user and selected project. Passwords are neither requested nor stored.
shell.tokenStorage: The Keystone token is written only to this shell’s temporary {path} and disappears when the container stops.
shell.persistentHome: A {size} GiB persistent home for each user × project is retained in the dedicated Cloud Shell project.
shell.sessionLifetime: The session ends at the earliest of closing, 20 minutes of I/O inactivity, the maximum session duration, or token expiration. The next session requires authorization again.
shell.resetConfirm: Delete all data in the Cloud Shell persistent home for "{projectName}"? Close any active session first. Deleted data cannot be recovered.
shell.resetConfirmed: Cloud Shell persistent home deletion confirmed.
shell.resizeAria: Resize Cloud Shell height: use the up and down arrow keys
shell.resizeTitle: Drag or use the up and down arrow keys to adjust the height
shell.error.ticketExpired: The authorization ticket or sign-in session has expired.
shell.error.permission: Cloud Shell connection permission or origin validation failed.
shell.error.idleTimeout: The session ended after 20 minutes without I/O.
shell.error.activeSession: Cloud Shell is already running in another tab or project.
shell.error.maxLifetime: The maximum session duration or Keystone token lifetime has been reached.
shell.error.infrastructure: Failed to prepare or connect to Cloud Shell infrastructure.
shell.error.reservationExists: Cloud Shell authorization is already in progress. Try again shortly.
shell.error.tokenExpiring: Couldn't start a new Cloud Shell because the Keystone token is about to expire.
shell.error.workspaceBusy: The persistent home is in use. Close the active Cloud Shell first.
shell.error.workspaceError: The persistent home volume is in an error state. An operator needs to investigate.
shell.error.quotaExceeded: The Cloud Shell service project has insufficient quota.
shell.error.imagePullFailed: Failed to pull the Cloud Shell image on Zun compute.
shell.error.cinderUnavailable: Couldn't check the Cloud Shell persistent home storage.
shell.error.zunUnavailable: The Zun Cloud Shell runtime is unavailable.
shell.error.coordinationLost: The Cloud Shell session coordination connection was lost.
shell.error.cleanupPending: Session cleanup is not finished yet. Try again shortly.
shell.error.busy: The Cloud Shell session or persistent home is currently in use.
shell.error.unavailable: Cloud Shell infrastructure is currently unavailable.
shell.error.session: An error occurred in the Cloud Shell session.
shell.error.protocol: The Cloud Shell control message is invalid.
shell.error.websocket: Failed to connect to the Cloud Shell WebSocket.
shell.error.unexpectedClose: The Cloud Shell connection closed unexpectedly.
shell.error.reset: Failed to reset the Cloud Shell persistent home.
